Preserve project reopen behavior and do not hide growth by forcing extra GC or restarting the process.

requirements: the same 50 MB project fixture is used for every cycle
the harness exposes an identical settle/GC checkpoint after close
heap/allocation snapshots are available after cycles 1, 10, and 20
project reopen behavior must remain correct
process restart or additional forced-GC calls are prohibited as the fix

evidence: retention ownership is causally tied to lifecycle completion
the fix releases ownership rather than masking memory metrics
